query: What is Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY?
fullAnswer:
**Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)** is the largest health assurance scheme in the world, managed by the National Health Authority. 

### **Overview**
The scheme aims to provide a health cover of **₹5 lakhs per family per year** for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization to over 12 crores poor and vulnerable families (approximately 55 crore beneficiaries), forming the bottom 40% of the Indian population.

### **Key Benefits**
* **Health Cover:** Up to Rs. 5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
* **Cashless & Paperless:** Access to healthcare services at the point of service in any empanelled public or private hospital across India.
* **Pre and Post-Hospitalization:** Covers up to 3 days of pre-hospitalization and 15 days of post-hospitalization expenses, including diagnostics, medicines, and consultations.
* **No Restrictions:** There are no restrictions on family size, age, or gender.
* **Pre-existing Conditions:** All pre-existing medical conditions are covered from day one.
* **Coverage Reset:** The ₹5 Lakh health insurance cover resets automatically every financial year for eligible family beneficiaries.
* **Portability:** The Ayushman card is portable across all empanelled hospitals in India.

### **Eligibility Criteria**
* **Rural Families (SECC-2011 Deprivation Categories D1 to D7):** 
  * *D1:* Only one room with kucha walls and kucha roof.
  * *D2:* No adult member between age 16 to 59.
  * *D3:* Female-headed households with no adult male member between age 16 to 59.
  * *D4:* Disabled member and no able-bodied adult member.
  * *D5:* Landless households deriving a major part of their income from manual casual labour.
  * *D7:* Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) households.
  * *Automatically included:* Destitute, living on alms, manual scavenger households, primitive tribal groups, and legally released bonded labour.
* **Urban Families (SECC-2011 Occupational Categories):** Includes ragpickers, beggars, domestic workers, street vendors/cobblers/hawkers, construction workers/plumbers/masons/laborers/painters/welders/security guards/coolies, sweepers/sanitation workers/malis, home-based workers/artisans/tailors/handicraft workers, transport workers/drivers/conductors, shop workers/assistants/peons, washermen/chowkidars, and electricians/mechanics/repair workers.
* **Senior Citizens (Aged 70+):** All senior citizens aged 70 years and above are eligible for dedicated health insurance cover of ₹5 Lakh per year under the expanded scheme, regardless of their socio-economic status.

### **Documents Required**
To verify eligibility and generate an Ayushman Card (Golden Card), beneficiaries need:
1. **Aadhaar Card:** Primary identification document mandatory for biometric or OTP-based e-KYC authentication.
2. **Ration Card / Family ID:** Proof of family composition and SECC database linkage.
3. **Active Mobile Number:** Required for receiving OTP during authentication and card download.
4. **Government Photo ID:** Voter ID or Driving License (in case of auxiliary verification).

### **How to Apply & Get an Ayushman Card**
Eligible beneficiaries can obtain their card through the following methods:
1. **Online (Beneficiary Portal / Ayushman App):**
   * Visit the [Beneficiary Portal](https://beneficiary.nha.gov.in/) or open the official Ayushman App.
   * Login with your mobile number and authenticate via OTP.
   * Select your State, Scheme (PMJAY), and search using your Aadhaar Number, Family ID, or PMJAY ID.
   * Complete e-KYC using Aadhaar OTP, Fingerprint, or Face Authentication.
   * Download and print the generated Ayushman Card.
2. **Offline at an Empanelled Hospital:** Visit any empanelled public or private hospital, meet the Ayushman Mitra at the dedicated help desk, and provide your Aadhaar Card and Ration Card to verify eligibility and generate the card on the spot.
3. **Offline at a Common Service Center (CSC / Jan Seva Kendra):** Visit the nearest CSC with your Aadhaar card and Ration card where an operator will perform e-KYC and issue the card.

### **Scheme Duration & Validity**
There is **no last date or closing deadline** for Ayushman Bharat (AB-PMJAY). It is a continuous, permanent national health scheme, and eligible citizens as well as senior citizens aged 70+ can apply and generate their cards at any time throughout the year.

query: What is Ayushman Bharat?
fullAnswer:
**Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)** is the largest health assurance scheme in the world. According to official government guidelines, it aims to provide health cover to over 12 crores poor and vulnerable families (approximately 55 crore beneficiaries) that form the bottom 40% of the Indian population.

### Key Benefits
* **Health Cover:** Provides up to **₹5,00,000 (Five Lakhs)** per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
* **Cashless and Paperless Access:** Available at the point of service in any empanelled public or private hospital across India.
* **Hospitalization Expenses:** Covers up to 3 days of pre-hospitalization and 15 days of post-hospitalization expenses, including diagnostics, medicines, and consultation.
* **Family Details:** There is **no restriction on family size, age, or gender**.
* **Pre-existing Conditions:** All pre-existing medical conditions are covered from day one.
* **Coverage Reset:** The ₹5 Lakh health insurance cover resets automatically every financial year for eligible family beneficiaries.
* **Portability:** The Ayushman card is portable across all empanelled hospitals in India.

### Eligibility Criteria
* **Rural Families (SECC-2011 Deprivation Categories D1 to D7):**
  * **D1:** Only one room with kucha walls and kucha roof.
  * **D2:** No adult member between age 16 to 59.
  * **D3:** Female-headed households with no adult male member between age 16 to 59.
  * **D4:** Disabled member and no able-bodied adult member.
  * **D5:** Landless households deriving a major part of their income from manual casual labour.
  * **D7:** Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) households.
  * **Automatically Included:** Destitute, living on alms, manual scavenger households, primitive tribal groups, and legally released bonded labour.

* **Urban Families (SECC-2011 Occupational Categories):**
  1. Ragpicker
  2. Beggar
  3. Domestic worker
  4. Street vendor / Cobbler / hawker / Other service provider working on streets
  5. Construction worker / Plumber / Mason / Labor / Painter / Welder / Security guard / Coolie and other head-load worker
  6. Sweeper / Sanitation worker / Mali
  7. Home-based worker / Artisan / Tailor / Handicraft worker
  8. Transport worker / Driver / Conductor / Helper to drivers and conductors / Cart puller / Rickshaw puller
  9. Shop worker / Assistant / Peon in small establishment / Helper / Delivery assistant / Attendant / Waiter
  10. Washerman / Chowkidar
  11. Electrician / Mechanic / Assembler / Repair worker

* **Senior Citizens (Aged 70+):**
  * All senior citizens aged 70 years and above are eligible for dedicated health insurance cover of ₹5 Lakh per year under the expanded scheme, regardless of socio-economic status.

### Documents Required
To verify eligibility and generate an Ayushman Card (PM-JAY Golden Card), beneficiaries need:
1. **Aadhaar Card:** Primary identification document mandatory for biometric or OTP-based e-KYC authentication.
2. **Ration Card / Family ID:** Proof of family composition and SECC database linkage.
3. **Active Mobile Number:** Required for receiving OTP during authentication and card download.
4. **Government Photo ID:** (Voter ID / Driving License) in case of auxiliary verification.

### Application Process (How to Get an Ayushman Card)
Eligible beneficiaries can obtain their card through the following methods:

1. **Online via Beneficiary Portal or Ayushman App:**
   * Visit the official portal at [https://beneficiary.nha.gov.in/](https://beneficiary.nha.gov.in/) or open the official Ayushman App.
   * Login using your mobile number and authenticate via OTP.
   * Select your State, Scheme (PMJAY), and search by Aadhaar Number, Family ID, or PMJAY ID.
   * Complete e-KYC using Aadhaar OTP, Fingerprint, or Face Authentication.
   * Download and print the generated Ayushman Card.

2. **Offline at an Empanelled Hospital (Ayushman Mitra Help Desk):**
   * Visit any empanelled public or private hospital.
   * Meet the Ayushman Mitra at the dedicated help desk.
   * Provide your Aadhaar Card and Ration Card to verify eligibility and generate the card on the spot.

3. **Offline at a Common Service Center (CSC / Jan Seva Kendra):**
   * Visit the nearest CSC with your Aadhaar card and Ration card.
   * The CSC operator will perform e-KYC and issue the card.

### Scheme Duration and Validity
* **No Last Date:** There is **no last date or closing deadline** for Ayushman Bharat (AB-PMJAY). It is a continuous, permanent national health scheme of the Government of India.
* Eligible citizens and senior citizens aged 70+ can apply and generate their cards at any time throughout the year.
